value.content:
# Incident Report: September 30, 2026: Domain Routing Disruption

On September 30, 2026, domains hosted on Railway returned 404 not found errors for new connections for a five minute period for all customers.

While rolling out a change to our distributed routing control plane, the new deployment didn’t wait for the schema updates needed to support new functionality. Our distributed routing control plane is the system that tells our origin proxies how to route user requests to the workloads behind every domain.

Because of this mismatch, route lookups failed, and any attempt to reach a domain served by Railway-hosted workloads returned an error. During the incident period, our origin proxies treated each failed lookup as if "this domain doesn't exist" instead of falling back to the last route it knew.

After five minutes of the system automatically reconciling to the intended working state - it restored most traffic; then routing recovered on its own as soon as the schema update finished.

## Impact

On September 30, 2026, between roughly 07:35 and 07:40 UTC, new connections to domains hosted on Railway (which include custom domains and `*.up.railway.app` domains) returned HTTP 404 in all regions.

Public access and some private networking lookups between services failed during this window. User service uptime was not impacted, only access as workloads kept running throughout we are able to confirm that no data was lost.

## Incident Timeline

*All times are UTC on September

value.content:
# Vercel Integration, Codespaces, and CLI

# Vercel Integration

Railway can now hook into Vercel to provide your production and preview deploys with access to your railway environments.

This means that if you add the Postgres plugin to your Railway project, we'll update Vercel with a `DATABASE_URL` connection string, accessible via envvars.

Just tell us which Railway environment to sync, and we'll do the rest.

![](https://cms.railway.com/media/c224041b2f3444b2770b7fa21911062e99f140851a49dd7607f8fa38a13958da.gif)

This is the first of many integrations to come. We already have a few more
planned, but if you'd like a specific integration, please join the
[Discord](https://discord.gg/xAm2w6g) and let us know.

# Codespaces

Railway is now fully compatible with [Github Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces).

Codespaces allows you to
develop entirely in the cloud. Use Railway to connect to your favorite infrastructure, and deploy straight from codespaces with `railway up`.

![](https://cms.railway.com/media/f2ea452147b015e892a12a9fa43299edca98aa702cb0001aff55c641bb4b5fb9.png)

Above is our [Railway Images](https://github.com/railwayapp/railway-images) starter, which uses Prisma and Railway to host a simple image grid, using Railway's Postgres as a backend. Live now on [Vercel](https://railway-images-vercel.vercel.app/)

# Improved UI/UX of CLI

The CLI comes new and improved in this update, featuring:

- 🌈 Added colours
- 🚨 Better error messages
- 🌍 Support for `railway login` in SSH or codespaces terminals
value.title: Vercel Integration, Codespaces, and CLI

value.description: Pay only for what your app uses, by the second. No overprovisioning, no idle markup.

faq.answer: Hobby is for indie hackers and developers to build and deploy personal projects. Pro is for professional developers and their teams shipping to production. Enterprise is for dev teams building and deploying production applications with large replica size, SLA, and/or compliance needs.
faq.question: Which plan is right for me?

faq.answer: If you do not already have a Railway account, you can sign up for a free Trial by clicking Login on railway.com.
faq.question: How do I get started with the free Trial?

faq.answer: When you sign up for the free Trial, you will receive a one-time grant of $5 in credits that you can use to try out Railway. The credits will be applied towards any usage on the platform and expire in 30 days. If you upgrade to a plan while you still have a credit balance from the trial, the remaining balance will carry over to your new plan.
faq.question: How does the Trial work?

faq.answer: Your Hobby plan subscription includes $5 of usage per month. If your total usage at the end of your billing period is $5 or less, you will not be charged extra for usage. If your total usage exceeds $5 in any given billing period, you will be charged total usage.
faq.question: How does the Hobby plan included usage work?

faq.answer: Included usage is reset at the end of every billing cycle and does not accumulate over time.
faq.question: Does included usage on Hobby accumulate?

faq.answer: Sandboxes run on Railway's VM primitive and bill on VM rates: $50 per GB of memory per month and $50 per vCPU per month, metered per second, plus $0.05 per GB of egress. You pay for the CPU a sandbox actually uses and the memory it holds while running, not for wall-clock uptime, so a sandbox waiting on a model or a user costs almost nothing. Destroyed sandboxes cost nothing, and an idle timeout destroys forgotten ones automatically. Sandbox usage draws from the same included credit as the rest of your plan.
faq.question: How are sandboxes billed?

faq.answer: When you make a payment, you will receive an email with your invoice and receipt attached. You can also find your billing history in Account > Billing.
faq.question: How can I get a receipt?

faq.answer: Head to Account > Billing and click 'Manage Subscription'. From there, you can update your billing information, including billing address and Tax ID.
faq.question: How to add company details on my invoice?

faq.answer: Railway accepts credit cards for plan subscriptions and usage. We support invoice payments for customers on the Enterprise plan.
faq.question: What payment methods are accepted?

faq.answer: Yes. As a new Railway user, you can sign up for a free Trial. You will receive a one-time grant of $5 to use on resources.
faq.question: Can I try Railway without a credit card?

faq.answer: You can upgrade any time, and when you do, you will get to the features of your new plan, as well as access to more powerful resources, immediately. When you downgrade, the changes will take effect at the beginning of your next billing cycle.
faq.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade at any time?

faq.answer: When you cancel your subscription, if you're on Hobby or Pro, your plan will remain active through the end of your current billing period, and any usage will be charged at the end of the period. If you are on the Hobby plan and using prepaid credits as your payment method, your subscription will be canceled immediately and any credit balance you may have will be forfeited.
faq.question: What happens when I cancel my subscription?

200.description:
Search Railway's one-click deploy templates through the machine-readable template index (railway.com/deploy/llms.txt, about 7,000 templates): code, name, description, validation status (validated, degraded, unvalidated by Railway's validation fleet), page URL and manifest URL. All `q` words must match the name, description or code; exact and prefix name matches rank first. Filter by `status`, page with `limit`/`offset`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `templates` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | string | Template code for get_template. |
| `description` | string |  |
| `manifest_url` | string |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `status` | string | validated, degraded or unvalidated. |
| `url` | string |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
